title: SDK User-Perspective Test Playbook
desc: Systematic QA playbook for the public SDK launcher from a first-time user perspective. Each step: run command, check exit code and output, file suggest on deviation.
steps: KNOWN SDK-LAUNCHER BEHAVIOR: launcher connects to whichever wkappbot Eye is running on the machine. In dev env with private Eye active, commands route to private core. For isolated testing use wkappbot-core.exe directly.

SDK QA FLOW: for user-visible launcher/CDP bugs, start from this playbook, then run the matching wkask/wkcdp smoke and compare exit code plus output against the first-time-user baseline before diagnosing internals.
EVIDENCE RULE: on any failure, keep the exact command, exit code, and smoke output together so the same user path can be replayed without re-deriving context.
author: claude
